Messages.Author: Alex Harmon
Messages.Body:
This came up in our play group tonight:

Can a ready vampire play Change of Target _after_ already playing a Kiss
of Ra? Since the action was indeed blocked, can't CoT be played?

Thanks in advance.

Alex

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Alex Harmon wrote:
> Can a ready vampire play Change of Target _after_ already playing a Kiss
> of Ra? Since the action was indeed blocked, can't CoT be played?

Change of Target - Action Modifier
* Change of Target cannot be used if the action is blocked by some means
other than blocking the acting minion (e.g., Brujah Frenzy, Kiss of
Ra). [LSJ 24-FEB-1998]

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Fri, 12 May 2000, Alex Harmon wrote:
> Can a ready vampire play Change of Target _after_ already playing a Kiss
> of Ra? Since the action was indeed blocked, can't CoT be played?

I am not LSJ but:

With Kiss of Ra, the opposing vampire does not block the action - the card
text of Kiss of Ra does. change of target requires a blocking minion to
"untap" (as per card text). So it cannot be played:

Change of Target cannot be used if the action is blocked by some means
other than blocking the acting minion (e.g., Brujah Frenzy, Kiss of

Ra). [LSJ 19980224]
